**Finding: missing (INSURANCE)**

The Agreement has no insurance covenant. The single reference to "insurance" (p0051) is only a cost pass-through obliging *Licensee* to bear insurance charges — it imposes nothing on Licensor. GENERAL PROVISIONS (p0144–p0159) covers governing law through representation by counsel with no insurance sub-clause, and no separate insurance heading exists in the outline.

Because Licensor supplies and supports the E-Path FX trading platform and handles our data and Confidential Information, the complete absence of coverage sits in walk-away territory under the rule. I inserted a new sub-clause (l) after p0159 at the preferred position (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request, term plus one year), with the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback offered in the negotiation comment. Redline validated (ok:true) and finding submitted.
